title: Forms of the Azure Hawk-Shield
summary: Sets out the school's hawk-shield forms from guard to dive for students who hold a lower shield manual.

title: The Two-Track Shield Discourse
summary: A discourse on keeping a shield guard and a shield strike on separate tracks that never cross.

title: Basin and River Shield Art
summary: Sets out the school's art of gathering blows in a basin and letting the river of the shield turn them.

title: The Hawk Court Great Shield Rites
summary: Sets out the great shield rites of the school's court for masters at the top of the mortal tiers.

title: Higher Forms of the Paired Wing
summary: Sets out the xiantian forms of two shields moving as the paired wings of one hawk.

title: The Azure Sky-Mirror Shield Canon
summary: Records the school's core-level shield forms in which the formed core fills the board like a mirror of the sky.

title: Oath-Taker's Shield Forms
summary: Sets out the shield forms taught to those who have sworn the shield oath and hold a lower manual.

title: The Windbreak Shield Discourse
summary: A discourse on standing as a windbreak in front of comrades and blunting every attack that rises.

title: Plateau Guard Great Forms
summary: Sets out the great forms of the plateau guard for bearers who hold open ground against many.

title: Sworn-Wind Shield Art
summary: Sets out the school's art in which a sworn bearer turns the wind of attack against its source.

title: Forms of the Long Bearing
summary: Sets out xiantian forms in which one bearing is held across a whole field by shield and qi.

title: The Open-Sky Oath Shield Canon
summary: Records the school's core-level oath forms in which the formed core holds the guard under the open sky.
